fields.v: Governance-conversion loop: 1. velocity exposes failure; 2. human classifies failure (local vs structural); 3. governance conversion (probabilistic, e.g. agent harness, or deterministic, e.g. type system); 4. future work constrained; 5. governability compounds. Agent work passes staged incorporation gates (sentinel first-commit early abort, pre-commit hook, merge-train batching, staged deploy gates). Project stages: feasibility probe, PowerPoint prototype, format expansion, SaaS, standards conformance, hardening

fields.v: Limitations: governance interpreted, not measured; velocity metrics (LOC, commits) hard to interpret; single Subject (N=1) and one toolchain; selective memory, retrospective rationalisation and confirmation bias (Subject also analyst); expert subject, unclear for non-experts or teams; future model capabilities may change findings; harm to the Subject from sustained agentic work. Gaps / future work: test propositions (velocity exposure via repository mining, soft-control saturation via controlled experiments, conversion compounding via longitudinal comparison, judgment and authority via interviews/surveys); tools to distinguish local from structural defects; organisational authority for governance in teams
